notes.title: Salto is Live!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that our first game Salto is now available for free download here on Steam: wake up on a rooftop and explore the world of your dreams! 

Unlock new powers as you progress and start further along your path if you happen to fall into the clouds and wake up. The game is even more fun with two players, enabling you to pull and boost your companion to explore new places in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39989544/26ce507b11dccfcd235befd751b36b83564078e7.png[/img]

We’d love feedback on the gameplay experience in the[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1559810] community area[/url] and look forward to adjusting the gameplay over the coming weeks. 

Enjoy your dreams!

Andrzej, Michal and Steve.
Timewarp Labs
